# IPLocate

IPLocate provides current geolocation, network, privacy, hosting, company, and abuse intelligence for IP addresses.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/iplocate/.

## Actions

- **Look Up IP Address** (read-only): Look up current geolocation, network, ASN, privacy, hosting, company, and abuse intelligence for one IPv4 or IPv6 address.
